column4: tests (a failing check listed here does not fail the run; remove the row once the consumer is fixed)

column1: # tests is optional: comma-separated package:TestName entries (package as `go test` prints it). With it, only those tests may fail; any other failing test, build failure, panic or timeout still fails the run. Without it, the whole check is waived.

column3: app/admin and app/players tests GET "/" and expect a session cookie or CSRF token; GoSX v0.57.2 (#430) sets none for anonymous reads. Consumer must create the session first.

cache tests run in development mode; GoSX serves hashed Go WASM no-cache outside production. Consumer tests must set APP_ENV=production. Also, since GoSX v0.60.0 the scene package imports m31labs.dev/gosx/assetpipe/manifest (a small types-only package, #796); the consumer's wasm dependency guard forbids the assetpipe prefix and must allow that one subpackage. Also, GoSX v0.60.0 requires Selena v0.5.3, which moves the consumer's own Selena requirement forward; its committed generated binding descriptors (table/materials) then differ from the compiler and must be regenerated.

fight/proof.go calls scene.CompileSelenaMaterial in a js/wasm build. Since GoSX v0.60.0 (#801) the Selena compiler is not built for js/wasm unless the build passes -tags gosx_selena_compiler. Consumer must add that tag, move the call behind //go:build !js, or load build-time .sel.json artifacts.

internal/bridge/gosx.go uses sim.Runner, sim.New and sim.Options in a js/wasm build. Since GoSX v0.60.0 (#793) the sim server types are built only outside js/wasm; shared types are in sim/simcore. Consumer must put that file behind //go:build !js || !wasm or split the server wiring out of it.
